_comment: Per-label event detection overrides. Loaded at bot startup by predict.py.

_fields.onnx_ceiling: ONNX confidence must be BELOW this for event override to fire. Set to 0.60 to ALWAYS check the event index, bypassing even 99%+ ONNX predictions. Set lower (e.g. 0.60) so event only overrides when ONNX is already uncertain.
_fields.min_sim: Minimum cosine similarity in the event embedding index to accept the match. Higher = stricter (fewer false positives). Default global: 0.93. Use 0.96+ for custom-character event pokemon with few original images.
_fields.min_margin: Minimum margin between #1 and #2 event similarity to accept the match. Default 0.005. Set lower (e.g. 0.001) for degenerate clusters where event variants are nearly identical in embedding space.

_strategy.custom_characters: Original-design event pokemon (peakychu, mosslax, smearguru, etc.) that look nothing like any real pokemon MUST have high min_sim (0.96+) and low onnx_ceiling (0.60-0.70) to avoid false-overriding confident correct ONNX predictions.
_strategy.costumed_base_pokemon: Event variants of a real pokemon (pokopia_ditto, dj_rotom, etc.) can use lower min_sim and higher onnx_ceiling since they share visual features with their base form.
_strategy.degenerate_clusters: Event labels that are nearly identical in embedding space (e.g. Pride Flag Vivillons) need low min_margin (0.001) to allow override despite tiny inter-label margins. The reported confidence is the ONNX confidence, not embedding similarity â€” embedding similarity is not a real probability.
